title: CCGT Power Plants Instrumentation & Control (I&C) Maintenance Manager
desc:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding engages in various sectors, primarily energy, shipbuilding, finance, and real estate industries. The Group is the only owner, operator and builder of the first Powership™ (floating power plant) fleet in the world and plays an active role in medium to long-term investments with more than 2.500 employees around the world in different 19 countries in Europe, Africa, Latam and Asia.
About Karpowership
Karpowership, part of the Karadeniz Holding, is the owner, operator and builder of the only Powership™ (floating power plant) fleet in the world and plays an active role in medium to long-term investments; providing access to fast-track, affordable and reliable electricity. Powerships have a range of 30 MW to 470 MW and are delivered ready to operate in less than 60 days. Currently, Karpowership owns and operates over than 30 Powerships with an installed capacity exceeding 3,500 MW and another 5,000 MW are under construction or in the pipeline. In addition to a Powership fleet, Karpowership owns and operates its own LNG fleet. With expertise and experience in the field, Karpowership serves as a one-stop-shop for LNG to Power solutions, as a single provider delivering all parts of the value chain; including but not limited to LNG sourcing, transport, delivery, regasification, and electricity production; with the mission of powering life wherever needed. With more than 2,000 employees globally; Karpowership is operational in Mozambique, Ghana, Sierra Leone, Guinea Bissau, Gambia, Senegal, Sudan, Ivory Coast, New Caledonia, Brazil, Dominican Republic and Cuba.
We are looking fo
r a CCGT Power Plants Instrumentation & Control (I&C) Maintenance Manager
to join our Turbine Plants, Occupational Safety and Environment at our Head Office located in
Kağıthane, Istanbul.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Electronics Engineering.
Minimum 8 years of experience in Gas Turbine Combined Cycle Power Plants.
Strong background in maintenance, reliability, technical support and training activities.
Demonstrated experience in the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, optimization, and lifecycle management of power plant control, instrumentation, and automation systems, including Valmet DNA/DCS, Siemens PCS 7, Siemens T3000, Mitsubishi MELSEC Steam Turbine Control Systems, and Woodward Gas Turbine Control Systems
Advanced English communication skills.
Good knowledge of MS Office and SAP.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
Lead planning and execution of major I&C maintenance outages, overhauls and preventive maintenance programs.
Develop and implement fleet-wide maintenance standards and best practices.
Provide technical leadership during major failures, plant disturbances and performance issues.
Coordinate OEMs, engineering specialists and service providers during troubleshooting activities.
Support root cause analysis investigations and ensure lessons learned are deployed fleet-wide.
Support Management of Change (MOC) processes and technical improvement initiatives.
Support commissioning, mobilization, COD, handover and demobilization activities.
Drive competency development and technical training programs for I&C personnel.
Monitor maintenance effectiveness, schedule compliance and asset reliability performance.
Support spare parts, service contract and maintenance budget optimization activities.
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with company standards and procedures.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
Hybrid working opportunity,
One day off on your birthday,
Comprehensive Private Health Insurance,
Professional and personal training & development opportunities,
Exclusive discounts and campaigns for employees.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
